goals: Determine where and how the engine should live on the Proxmox server (which VM/container, what resources) and document that placement decision
Serve larger local models on the Tesla P40 (24 GB) in VM 110 ai-vm so the engine can call them for inference
Deploy the engine's services (orchestrator, Postgres, Milvus, Redis, Open WebUI, pipelines, SearXNG) on the server so the engine runs there
Point the server-side engine's inference at the P40-served models instead of laptop Ollama / Ollama Cloud
Set up the server-side engine so it can be tested and refined against the larger local models
Keep the existing laptop engine (10.9.8.43) intact and running as the current working instance during the move
title: Move scaffold engine onto Proxmox server
ambiguities: Should the server-side engine fully replace the laptop engine, or run alongside it for now? Options: (a) run both, laptop stays the live one while the server is tested — safest, nothing breaks; (b) switch over to the server once it works and retire the laptop engine; (c) keep both permanently, each for different jobs.

What should the engine be able to do with the larger models that it can't do today? Options: (a) just answer bigger/better prompts and generate longer text; (b) run heavier reasoning or multi-step tasks that are too slow on CPU; (c) fine-tune or refine the engine's own behavior using the larger models; (d) something else — describe the outcome you want.

How much of the engine's data (Postgres, Milvus, Redis contents) should move to the server? Options: (a) start the server engine empty and let it rebuild its own data; (b) copy the laptop's current data over so the server starts where the laptop is; (c) keep data only on the laptop and have the server engine read from it.

Which larger models do you want served on the P40? Options: (a) a general-purpose large chat/code model that fits in 24 GB VRAM; (b) a specific model family you already use or want to try; (c) let the engine pick the best model that fits the P40 — describe only what you want it to be good at (code, general chat, long documents, etc.).

VM 110 ai-vm has only 16 GB RAM and 100 GB disk, which is tight for model files and the engine's services. Options: (a) expand ai-vm's RAM/disk from the host's free resources; (b) run the engine's services in a separate VM/container and keep ai-vm only for the model server; (c) keep everything in ai-vm and accept the tight limits.

Should the engine's services run in a container on the Proxmox host, in a new VM, or inside ai-vm? Options: (a) a new container/VM dedicated to the engine services, separate from the model server; (b) inside ai-vm alongside the model server; (c) let the engine decide based on the hardware and pick the cleanest fit.

Is the laptop's Ollama Cloud subscription meant to stay in use after the move, or should the server engine stop using cloud inference once the P40 models work? Options: (a) keep cloud as a fallback; (b) stop using cloud once local P40 models are serving; (c) keep cloud for some tasks and local for others.

What does 'tested and refined' look like to you as a success signal? Options: (a) the engine can run its normal tasks on the server and you can see it working; (b) you can compare the server engine's answers against the laptop engine's and pick the better one; (c) the engine can adjust its own prompts/behavior using the larger models and show measurable improvement; (d) describe the outcome you want to see.
constraints: PRESERVE the existing Proxmox host, its VMs, and the ZFS pool 'oasis' — modify in place; do NOT reinstall the OS or wipe any disks
PRESERVE the existing laptop engine at 10.9.8.43 — do not tear it down or migrate data destructively
VM 110 ai-vm is running with only ssh open and no model server yet — build the model serving there without reinstalling its OS
VM 100 gpu-vm (GTX 1060 3 GB) is stopped — leave it stopped unless the plan decides it is needed
The engine already drives this host through its runner (pve-runner, helper 23) — reuse that path rather than inventing a new control channel
Hardware budget on the server: 48 threads, ~88 GB RAM available, P40 24 GB on ai-vm (8 cores / 16 GB RAM / 100 GB disk), ZFS 'oasis' ~5.1 TB free, local-lvm ~400 GB free
ai-vm has only 16 GB RAM and 100 GB disk — larger models must fit within the P40's 24 GB VRAM and the VM's disk/RAM limits, or the plan must justify expanding the VM
description: Relocate the scaffold engine (currently running on the laptop at 10.9.8.43 via Docker Compose) so it runs on the Proxmox host (pve, 10.9.8.156), giving it access to larger local models served on the Tesla P40 (24 GB) passed through to VM 110 ai-vm. The engine should be set up so it can be tested and refined against those larger models, while the existing laptop setup remains available as the current working instance.
user_feedback:
Operator's answers to the brief's questions (2026-10-15), in their words:
1. Run both for now (the laptop engine stays live while the server engine is tested).
2. Heavier reasoning and multi-step work.
3. Agreed: start the server engine empty and let it build its own data.
4. Heavily focused on coding, engineering, and long reasoning.
5. We need drastic space for the media as well, so stick to 2 TB for now (the engine's and the models' storage on the server stays within 2 TB of the ZFS pool 'oasis'; the rest is kept for media).
6. Within the AI-VM (VM 110 ai-vm) -- that was the whole point of it: the engine's services AND the model server live there.
7. I'd like to widen our search to Hugging Face and truly unrestricted models.
8. Success = the engine situated on the server with the optimal configuration of LLM models to properly address the user's needs.
